text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Our classmates' mock race is coming up 
soon, right? I should start making 
cheering towels soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Name Towel" "How to make"... Hmm, let's 
see. Cut the felt into the shape of 
letters, then use adhesive—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yup, I might be able to make this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...... It's done for the most part, but 
are the letter sizes kind of all... over 
the place?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It really doesn't look very good, does it? 
Let's remake it one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Narita Top Road felt 
downhearted after remaking it over and 
over, only to fail each time.
